android.desc:
Vianta brings your Android phone and your Mac together into one seamless workspace. Move files, share your clipboard, mirror notifications, and more — instantly, over your own Wi-Fi network. There's no cloud, no account, and no waiting. Everything happens directly between your devices and stays on them.

FAST, PRIVATE FILE TRANSFER — ALWAYS FREE
Send photos, videos, documents, and even entire folders between your phone and Mac at full local-network speed. Large videos that would take ages to upload and email move in moments. There are no size limits, no sign-ups, and nothing is stored on a server. Transfers work in both directions: push from Android to your Mac, or drop files on your Mac to send them to your phone.

- No file size limits
- Photos, videos, documents, and whole folders
- Both directions, at full Wi-Fi speed
- A clear history of everything you've sent and received

DO MORE WITH VIANTA PRO
Vianta is completely free on Android. Connect a Mac running Vianta Pro and these features switch on automatically on your phone — there's no separate purchase to make on Android:

- Universal Clipboard — copy text on one device and paste it on the other
- Notification Mirroring — see your Android notifications on your Mac and dismiss them from either device
- Screenshot Sync — new screenshots you take on Android arrive on your Mac the moment you capture them
- Share Text & Links — send snippets, notes, and URLs between your devices in a single tap
- Menu Bar Glance — check your phone's battery and storage right from the Mac menu bar

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Vianta is built to keep your data yours. It connects your devices directly over your local Wi-Fi network, so your files, clipboard, and notifications never pass through any server or cloud. Nothing is uploaded, and nothing is stored outside your own devices.

EFFORTLESS SETUP
Open Vianta on your Mac and your phone on the same Wi-Fi network and they find each other automatically — or scan a QR code to pair instantly. Once connected, sending a file is as quick as a tap.

REQUIREMENTS
Vianta needs the companion Vianta app on your Mac, with both devices on the same Wi-Fi network. The app is free on Android; Vianta Pro is an optional subscription purchased on the Mac, and your paired Android unlocks Pro automatically while connected.

Bring your phone and your Mac closer together with Vianta.
